realized_metrics.window_convention: WP-12do / WP-S2c-78 uses the final local data-year evaluation window, 2025-04-12 through 2026-04-11, as H-004 selected pre-WP-5b combined R1+R2 cycle 1 after the original full-period no-formal-split retrospective baseline.
